AAVE is a decentralized non-custodial lending protocol. AAVE operates on public blockchains such as Ethereum. AAVE offers overcollateralized borrowing and lending. AAVE provides flash loans. AAVE is governed by holders of its AAVE token.

Pickle Finance is a yield optimizer that automatically compounds returns. Pickle Finance operates on public blockchains such as Ethereum. Pickle Finance accepts deposits of liquidity provider tokens into jars.

Jupiter Exchange is a decentralized exchange aggregator. Jupiter Exchange operates on the Solana blockchain. Jupiter Exchange routes trades across multiple liquidity sources.

Yearn Earn is a yield aggregator that allocates deposits across DeFi lending protocols. Yearn Earn operates through vaults into which users deposit assets. Yearn Earn is built on smart contracts on the Ethereum blockchain.
